title: Volormon
description: Cobblemon server with mods to enhance the cobblemon experience including: breeding, megas, tms, and much more!
body:
![Person running through a forest with pokemon around them.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/847efbfb590ca7b06a572257f65f7b879ddd40ea_0.webp)
Volormon pack is the offical modpack for the Voloron Network, a group of gamers and pokemon/minecraft enthusiest!

Taking pokemon and minecraft and merging them in a way never seen before using the cobblemon mod! This mod unlike others that already exist makes pokemon look like they actually exist in the world of minecraft! We offer some unique features to our modpack that others don't to enhance the players experience and making playing the game much easier without having to change settings or mod versions etc. Discord: https://discord.gg/66jqNJdJkD
